concerns.text: The specification (FR-004) defines a single pruning heuristic, but Task T007 implements two variants (fr04 and redundancy). No task verifies that the implemented heuristic matches the required FR-004 behavior, leaving the functional requirement potentially unmet.

Success Criterion SC-005 (compute feasibility: 6‑hour CI limit and 7 GB RAM constraint) is not covered by any task. There is no task that measures or asserts that the full experimental sweep completes within the allotted runtime and memory budget.
